sources.title: Qwopus3.5 9B v3 — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: Qwopus3.5 9B v3 is a compact multimodal model that handles both text and image inputs, making it versatile for vision-language tasks at a modest parameter count. Built on the Qwen3.5 family and published by Jackrong, it carries the open-weight flexibility that lets developers fine-tune or deploy it freely under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Qwopus3.5 9B V3.5 — Hardware Requirements & Compatibility
sources.snippet: Qwopus3.5 9B V3.5 — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat Reasoning Functions Qwopus3.5 9B V3.5 is a 9.7B-parameter open language model from Jackrong. It supports a context window of up to 262,144 tokens. At BF16 it needs about 19.87 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.
